messages.subject: job opportunity - Bioinformatics Scientist
parts:
I'm looking for a Ph.D.-level bioinformatician to join my group at the
Great Lakes Bioenergy Research Center in Madison, WI, USA. I need
someone who has experience analyzing high-throughput data such as
transcriptomics, metabolomics etc. Familiarity with next-gen
sequencing data will be a big plus. Data management and database
design skills are also desirable. See further details and application
instructions at http://www.ohr.wisc.edu/pvl/pv_065583.html

Thanks.

Yury
